tasks.title: Add lifecycle controller foundation
tasks.dod: Lifecycle states, transition rules, invalid-command no-ops, and subscription/read APIs are covered by deterministic unit tests without moving gameplay facts into the controller.

tasks.title: Add best-score service and terminal snapshots
tasks.dod: Validated localStorage best-score behavior, failure-reason mapping, and Game Over/Victory snapshot creation pass deterministic tests including storage failure cases.

tasks.title: Add core session reset APIs
tasks.dod: Score, protocol, current level, lives, timer, pause, mistake, and input reset APIs are exact, idempotent, and tested, with zero-lives semantics preserving level JSON values.

tasks.title: Add world-state reset APIs
tasks.dod: Snake, food, bonuses, active bonus effects, obstacle engine history, obstacle visual state, animation counters, and transient render state expose exact idempotent resets covered by unit tests.

tasks.title: Add session temporary-effect cleanup
tasks.dod: Life-lost timers, session-owned temporary handles, stale-session guards, and component timeout cleanup are deterministic and covered with fake-timer tests where appropriate.

tasks.title: Coordinate session reset and session commands
tasks.dod: Start, Play Again, Main Menu, full reset orchestration, best-score preservation, and 10 consecutive deterministic Play Again cycles pass integration tests.

tasks.title: Integrate lifecycle with React, R3F, input, and pause
tasks.dod: Frame advancement, input listener selection, pause/resume, terminal input ignoring, and StrictMode-safe listener cleanup are wired to lifecycle and tested.

tasks.title: Deliver Game Over result slice
tasks.dod: All supported Game Over reasons report to the controller, capture a snapshot before reset, render required result content, ignore terminal input, and no longer reload.

tasks.title: Deliver Victory result slice
tasks.dod: Final-level completion reports Victory to the controller, captures a snapshot, keeps the required result visible, and removes the automatic final-win reload.

tasks.title: Wire result actions and accessible lifecycle UI
tasks.dod: Play Again and Main Menu actions are keyboard and pointer accessible from both terminal screens, preserve best score, and leave non-active states guarded from movement and pause input.

tasks.title: Add browser lifecycle verification
tasks.dod: Playwright scenarios verify representative lifecycle paths, no reload, result-screen stability, terminal input ignoring, best score across refresh, Play Again, Main Menu, and Victory.

tasks.title: Finalize documentation and traceability
tasks.dod: Feature docs and review notes identify completed verification, trace FR/AC coverage, record remaining risks, and confirm no lifecycle implementation evidence is missing.
